movie.title: Troll 2
movie.overview: When a dangerous new troll unleashes devastation across their homeland, Nora, Andreas and Major Kris embark on their most perilous mission yet.

reviews.author: Manuel São Bento
reviews.content:
FULL SPOILER-FREE REVIEW @ https://fandomwire.com/troll-2-review/

Rating: C+

"Troll 2 is a sequel that, while competent and occasionally entertaining, struggles to find its own identity in the shadow of its predecessor.

It's a perfect example that sometimes more monsters and more destruction don't equate to a better story, and that movie magic often lies in what isn't seen rather than what's computer-generated to fill the screen.

The action scenes are indeed grandiose, and there's a deeper dive into Nordic mythology, but I couldn't shake the feeling that the rustic and palpable soul of this saga was polished until it lost its original shine, transforming an ancient legend into mere quick-consumption content."

reviews.author: MovieGuys
reviews.content:
"Trolls 2" feels somewhat like a remake of the original. There's little that's all that new on offer here. It builds in a very modest way, on the tale of Nordic trolls, from the first film. It introduces a few new ideas and twists but it fails to do anything truly original that would have made it a genuine successor to the first film. 

Action is well done but the finale feels like its comes and goes, all to quickly.

In summary, no harm in making a sequel but you do need to ensure it offers something more than what went before. Regrettably, Trolls 2 fails to build on the solid formula established in the first film. A mediocre watch.

reviews.author: jw
reviews.content:
The original Troll 2 was ... not exactly better, but more entertaining.


That's all I have to say about this.

reviews.author: Sierbahnn
reviews.content:
National treasure
Norway has a rich troll-tradition, and with Trollhunter, Troll, and now Troll 2, they are showing this off in the movies.

This is not as engaging as Troll was, but it is a lot slicker, and it has a definite National Treasure-vibe to it, which I adore.

The characters are likable, unique and relatable, the tension works, and the effects are more than just ok. This is a great movie.

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: When a colossal, ancient troll reawakens and threatens Norway with utter destruction, Nora Tidemann, Andreas Isaksen, and Major Kris Holm must reunite to unravel ancient myths and stop its devastating rampage.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: Following the events of the first film, recluse researcher Nora Tidemann is called back into action when a massive ancient troll awakens from hibernation. Joined by government advisor Andreas Isaksen and military leader Major Kris Holm, she embarks on a high-stakes adventure across Norway. To defeat this colossal force of nature, the team must uncover forgotten Norwegian history, unearth ancient secrets, and forge unexpected alliances to save their country from extinction.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: Years after surviving their first terrifying encounter with a mythical beast, paleontologist Nora Tidemann has withdrawn into seclusion, obsessively researching Norwegian folklore and the history of giant trolls. Her isolation ends when government official Andreas Isaksen brings her to a secret facility where an immense, dormant troll—dubbed a 'Megatroll'—is being studied. When the ancient behemoth unexpectedly awakens and breaks containment, it launches a destructive rampage across the country towards historical grounds. Nora, Andreas, and Major Kris Holm reunite on a perilous mission to track the creature and prevent absolute devastation. Realizing conventional military firepower is insufficient, the trio traverses dangerous mountain regions and historic sites to decode ancient folklore tied to Saint Olaf and the origins of Norway. Deep inside hidden tombs and cavernous mountains, they search for forgotten relics and clues. Facing strict government deadlines, rogue monster threats, and impossible odds, Nora and her allies must use every ounce of courage and historical knowledge to stop the rampage and restore balance before their homeland is completely destroyed.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: In this epic Norwegian monster sequel, an even larger, legendary troll reawakens from centuries of slumber to unleash widespread devastation across Norway. Reclusive scholar Nora Tidemann is forced out of hiding by her former allies, government strategist Andreas Isaksen and military veteran Major Kris Holm, to lead the charge against the towering threat. Facing a catastrophe that traditional defense methods cannot stop, the trio embarks on a perilous journey through ancient ruins, subterranean caverns, and historical sites to uncover forgotten folklore secrets capable of halting the creature's destruction before all of Norway falls.
